# Designators and areas

`game.designators` defines click and drag tools, and `game.areas` makes and edits allowed areas. The kit is Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md).

A tool has a `designate` callback and an optional `can_designate` that returns true, false or the reason a cell is not allowed. Set `drag = "box"` for rectangle and line dragging, and `category` to put the tool in an architect menu such as `Orders`. `target = "thing"` makes the callbacks receive a thing instead of a cell.

```lua
game.designators.add("mark_zone", { label = "Mark zone", desc = "Paint the Watch area", icon = "UI/Designators/ZoneCreate_Stockpile", drag = "box", color = "accent", category = "Orders" },
  function(cell) game.areas.set(cell.map, "Watch", cell.x, cell.z, true) end,
  function(cell) return game.maps.walkable(cell.map, cell.x, cell.z) or "Not walkable" end)
game.areas.create(game.maps.current(), "Watch")
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.designators.add` | `id, opts, designate, can_designate?, on_finished?` | `string` | Defines a click or drag tool. can_designate returns true, false or the reason it is not allowed. For thing tools the callbacks receive the thing. |
| `game.designators.add_to_architect` | `id, category` | `boolean` | Puts a tool in an architect category. |
| `game.designators.remove` | `id` | `boolean` | Removes a tool and takes it out of the architect menu. |
| `game.designators.activate` | `id` | `boolean` | Selects the tool as if the player clicked its button. |
| `game.designators.list` |  | `RimToolInfo[]` | Lua tools. |
| `game.areas.create` | `map, label` | `boolean` | Makes an allowed area. False when one with the label exists. |
| `game.areas.set` | `map, label, x, z, value` | `boolean` | Adds or removes a cell in an area. |
| `game.areas.cells` | `map, label` | `RimCell[]` | The cells of an area, at most 2000. |
| `game.areas.remove` | `map, label` | `boolean` | Deletes an area. |
